The unchanged raw report passes the repaired exported verifier with correlated_panel_materialization. verdict_A_spec_evidence.missing: The predicate does not enforce replacement materialization after old-panel destruction, even though the D274 expected/fix text requires it. It also does not enforce pre-click old-worker presence despite calling the final worker a replacement.
verdict_A_spec_evidence.could_not_verify: No fresh hosted native run or eligible normal CLI certificate was launched in this review. The raw archive remains immutable historical evidence; exported-function acceptance alone is not a normal certificate.

important_findings: At scripts/hosted-remote-admission.mjs:1208-1232, old-panel destruction and new-panel event are independent after-click existential checks. On the raw report, changing old-panel target_destroyed.at from 17:33:32.965Z to 17:33:36.965Z, later than the replacement target_info_changed at 17:33:34.908Z, still returns PASS correlated_panel_materialization. Moving the changed event before the destroy entry also passes. Add a forcing test for the order and require the matching materialization event to be after the old-panel destruction in both entry order and timestamp.

At scripts/hosted-remote-admission.mjs:1185-1205, deleting the old worker from pre_click_snapshot and setting pre_click_old_worker_present=false still passes the unchanged raw report. Require the owned old worker in that snapshot and the producer's flag, or explain in the contract why this evidence is dispensable.

At scripts/hosted-remote-admission.mjs:1223-1232, a report with replacement_panel_created_event=false plus an added owned target_created event for the same final replacement ID still passes through correlated_panel_materialization. The flags and timeline contradict. Add a refusal case so a false flag cannot mask a classified creation event.
